column16: London Fashion Week — influencer vs non-influencer

column1: Influencer content = collab posts on creators' accounts + Nancy posts tagging/featuring an influencer invoiced for that event (from the Influencer Invoices sheet). Influencer cost = that event's invoices; non-influencer cost = event cost − invoices. Cancun ad spend is campaign-level, so it's split by each group's share of boosted views. LFW uses Emma Louise Boynton's invoice from "General" ($12,337.64). Other general invoices (Dr. Jila, Cheri Cho, Nazanin Kavari) aren't assigned.
